name: ticket-checkout-escrow
description: Resale marketplace thin slice: ticket checkout with escrow and double-entry ledger

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tce/api && npm run build -w @tce/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tce/shared && npm run test -w @tce/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tce/api" "npm run dev -w @tce/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tce/api && npm run typecheck -w @tce/web
